quality_gate: Grounded advice must preserve native completion and zero protected-state violations.
practical_benefit_gate: Descriptive only: equal completion plus at least one fewer native repair attempt, or at least 10 percent lower both-passed median client wall time versus both controls. No superiority claim from two development task families.
failure_policy: Retain all timeouts and setup failures; no retry unchanged. Stop a client lane when isolation/launch fails before model execution.
missing_metrics: Keep unobserved first-useful-action timing, billed cost and repair counts unknown; tool counts are not repair attempts.
advice_control: Immutable local wrapper projects the selected style on every native CLI call; underlying exit and native oracle unchanged.
metrics_note: First native verification call is an observed proxy, not time to first useful action; failed native verification calls are not all repair attempts.
qualification: Use ./bin/steward; verify selected advice style in native-wrapper records. Earlier cohorts retained separately.
